name: Terfezia claveryi
notes: A hot-desert mycorrhiza; family is inferred. Its mycorrhiza form is reported (unchecked) to change with moisture, and it is reported to be cultivated in Spain.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): desert truffle with slow mycelium in culture; set at twice the family default because it must cross dry sand to find its host

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
